remark.page: 20 (pdf page), the remark after the proof of Theorem 1 and Remark 17
remark.text: We asked ChatGPT 5.6 Sol to perform an additional iteration of optimization in Theorem 14. A preliminary, unverified iteration suggests that Theorem 1 holds with G_AI(λ) = e^{−λ}(−0.3864λ + 0.8347λ^2 − 2.0156λ^3 + 2.7171λ^4 − 1.7541λ^5 + 0.4522λ^6). If verified it would improve the upper bound on the diagonal Ramsey numbers to R(k, k) ≤ (3.78233 . . .)^{k+o(k)}. Further improvements by performing additional iterations are possible, but we expect that lowering the base of the exponent below 3.7 and, likely, even below 3.75 would require new ideas.

usedFromThePaper: Theorem 14 (v2; Theorem 13 in v1): the three conditions and the conclusion R(k, l) <= e^{F(l/k)k + o(k)} for k >= l; M continuous
